subject: Psychology
central_question: How are abnormal behaviour and psychological disorders identified, explained, classified and distinguished through their characteristic symptoms?
in_scope_units: Neurodevelopmental, disruptive, eating and substance-related disorders
banned_topics: Medical treatment recommendations beyond the source

known_pitfalls.claim: Any unusual behaviour is a disorder.
known_pitfalls.correction: Context, culture, maladaptation and the four Ds must be considered.

known_pitfalls.claim: Reading symptoms is enough to diagnose.
known_pitfalls.correction: Diagnosis and treatment require specialised professional training.

recommended_example_progression: NCERT Activity 4.3 and Table 4.1: compare anxiety patterns.
NCERT Box 4.1: compare somatic and dissociative disorders.
NCERT Review Questions 9–11: analyse dissociation, phobia and anxiety.
ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: The end-of-chapter Review Questions contain Questions 1–11, followed by three Project Ideas.
